text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Whoooa! Birthday wishes from Prez!Cough! I choked!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, that's 'cause you're way too<n>happy.
Guess that means you're still<n>a kid at heart.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
But come on, this is Prez we're<n>talking about! How
else am I<n>supposed to react when someone I
respect so much wishes me happy<n>birthday?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Heh, I'm glad I said it then. But what<n>if I told you I
have a present for you<n>as well?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: A present from you?! Th-th-thank youso much!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I asked around about your tastes and<n>settled on
mango tarts—hopefully<n>they're up to your
standards.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Uwahhh! I LOVE mangoes! This is the<n>BEST
birthday ever!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Hnnghhh, I can't take this anymore!<n>Why do you
get to hog all the happy<n>memories?!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I knooow! But you can't make me<n>this jealous and
not expect me to<n>want some attention too!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Your own birthday is but two weeks<n>away... Have a
little patience.
